description: Top up your USD balance with crypto. Minimum $30, maximum $2000 per top-up. Bonus credit is applied automatically on confirmation: $100 → +$25, $250 → +$75, $500 → +$200, $1000 → +$500, $1500 → +$1000, $2000 → +$2000 (linear interpolation between anchors, no bonus below $100). Call topup_bonus first to see the full tier table. Returns a payment_id, deposit address and amount_crypto — send it from your wallet, then poll payment_status(order_id=payment_id) until status=confirmed.

account_token.description: optional Bearer token; if absent, a new account is created and the token is returned (STORE IT)

amount.description: USD amount to top up (min 30, max 2000)

dry_run.description: set true to preview the response without creating a real invoice

name: topup_create
